classification.text_en: The earth is a creation of God named beside the heavens. It is presented as a place made for people to live on, and the verse on seven heavens adds that of the earth there is 'the like of them', without explaining the likeness.

origin.text_en: God made the earth in two days, and in another passage spread it out after the heaven was built. People are told they were created from it, will be returned into it, and will be brought out of it once more.

purpose.text_en: A home and provision for people and their livestock: God made it a resting place with paths, and brought out of it its water and pasture as enjoyment for people and their animals.

nature.text_en: Described as a bed or carpet laid out for people, a cradle, spread out and made easy to walk upon, with mountains set in it and rivers and paths running through it.

abilities.text_en: It brings up plants in pairs when water comes down on it, it is revived after being dead, and on the Last Day, when it is shaken with its great shaking, it brings out its burdens.

limitations.text_en: It does not stand by itself: God holds the heavens and the earth so that they do not move away. It will be shaken on the Last Day, and it is the place people are made from and return to.

relationship_with_humans.text_en: God subjected what is in the earth for people and made it easy to walk on; they are told to eat of His provision. Adam and his wife were told they would have a dwelling and enjoyment on the earth for a time, and God told the angels He would place a successor in it.

quranic_events.text_en: Adam and his wife were sent down to the earth. At the end of the Flood the earth was told to swallow its water. Qarun and his house were made to sink into the earth, and he had no group to help him against God.

chronological_position.text_en: Two passages give an order. In one the earth is made in two days before God turns to the heaven; in another the earth is spread out after the heaven is built. Both are in the text and this profile does not reconcile them.

location.text_en: The earth is set below the sky: the verses call the earth a bed or carpet for people and the sky a building above it.

misconceptions.text_en: Educational interpretation (not scripture): Words such as bed, carpet and spread out are the Quran's own images of what the earth is for people. Reading them as a statement about the earth's shape or size is an extra step that these verses do not take and this profile does not take either.

lessons.text_en: Educational interpretation (not scripture): The Quran keeps pairing the earth's provision with gratitude, and it uses land that is revived after being dead as an example of the return of people to God.

vocabulary.text_en: Ard is earth or land; firash is a bed; mihad a cradle; bisat a carpet; dalul made easy; dahaha means He spread it out; sutihat means laid out; rawasi are firm mountains set in it.
